Max Verstappen won the Mexico City Grand Prix for Red Bull, climbing from fifth on the grid to take the win. Lewis Hamilton started on pole for Ferrari but finished second, 0.799 behind and with the fastest lap, while Andrea Kimi Antonelli took third for Mercedes. The classification also featured Liam Lawson's drive up from 22nd on the grid to seventh place.
highlights: Liam Lawson climbed from 22nd on the grid to finish seventh, the biggest move through the field of starters.
Lewis Hamilton set the fastest lap of the race while finishing second behind winner Max Verstappen.
Only the top ten classified drivers scored points, Ryo Hirakawa taking the final point in tenth place.

review.summary: Marc Marquez won the Grand Prix of Malaysia for Ducati Lenovo Team, with Pedro Acosta second for Red Bull KTM Factory Racing and Alex Marquez third for BK8 Gresini Racing MotoGP. No fastest lap was recorded. Four riders failed to complete the race: Johann Zarco, Diogo Moreira, Joan Mir and Augusto Fernandez.
highlights: Marc Marquez won for Ducati Lenovo Team, ahead of Pedro Acosta for Red Bull KTM Factory Racing and Alex Marquez for BK8 Gresini Racing MotoGP.
No fastest lap was recorded in the classification.
Four riders did not finish: Johann Zarco, Diogo Moreira, Joan Mir and Augusto Fernandez.
Iker Lecuona took the final point of the race for BK8 Gresini Racing MotoGP.
